messages:
Dmitri: Kicking off gateway fanout prime for api-gateway service v2.1.0 in eu-west. Change window 11:30-12:30 UTC. Plan: 0->10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (gradual) with health gating. Rollback on p95 > 300ms for 5m or error-rate > 1.5x baseline. Tagging ops oncall and @Alice M for console watch.
DeployBot: deploy started: id=deploy-20260321-1784256789, target=api-gateway:v2.1.0, mode=blue-green, region=eu-west.
Alice M: On it. I'll validate router priming + LB warm pool before we shift first tranche. Will post metrics snapshots.
Ben: Quick Q — are backend svc connections pinned to v2.1.0? we saw sticky conn issues last time.
Dmitri: Good catch. We pin route rules to target-tag=v2.1.0 for downstream services; session affinity remains via cookie with 2m TTL.
Carla: LB plan (brief):
```
# move weights via routerctl
routerctl set-weight gateway-eu-west blue 90 green 10 --hold 300s
# after steady: routerctl set-weight blue 50 green 50
```
Carla: We'll use hold windows between steps and sanity probes for 200s.
Eva L: I'll run a smoke against auth + billing stacks once 10% is live. Report in 3m.
DeployBot: healthcheck: /healthz returned 200 for all green nodes (n=12). KV cache primed.
Alice M: Metrics baseline (pre-roll): p50 30ms p95 120ms errors 0.02% 5xx 0.003%. Note saved to dashboard: /dash/eng/gateway/eu-west/baseline.
Dmitri: Start 10% now. Everyone stand by for p95/error jumps.
DeployBot: roll step complete: green=10% blue=90% (timestamp=1784256800).
Ben: Seeing a small uptick in a subset of pods (latency p95 -> 210ms). Drilling now, could be cold-start pattern.
Alice M: Watch for correlation with long tails in model cache misses. If persists >5m escalate to rollback.
Carla: Hold window extended +2m to observe.
DeployBot: probe-aggregation: p95 (green) 220ms, p95 (blue) 120ms, error-rate (green) 0.03%.
Dmitri: Not ideal but below our rollback threshold (1.5x error). If p95 stays >250ms next 3m we roll back.
Eva L: Auth smoke passed 10/10. Billing smoke 9/10 but one transient 502. Logging to the ticket.
Ben: I'm patching a config leak that may cause a few pods to reload. ETA 4m.
Dmitri: If reloads finish and p95 drops, continue to 50%. If not, immediate rollback.
DeployBot: admin note: canary-pin set for trace-sampling=yes on green nodes.
Alice M: +1 to pinning traces — helps triage. Preparing canary logs.
DeployBot: roll step initiated: green=50% blue=50% (timestamp=1784256820).
Dmitri: All eyes on p95 for next 10m. Ben please call if you see patterns beyond cache warm.
Ben: p95 (green) trending down to 160ms as pods finish init. errors stable. Looks safe to finish.
Dmitri: Proceeding to full fanout in 10m unless anyone objects.
Carla: Confirmed routerctl dry-run applied for final sweep.
Eva L: Final smoke queued for +8m.
DeployBot: final shift scheduled in 8m; rollback triggers still active.
Alice M: No objections. I'll keep dashboard pinned and run regression alerts.
Dmitri: Thanks team — continuing monitor. If we hit rollback triggers: plan is immediate weight revert to blue 100% + evict green nodes, and open incident channel.
Ben: Noted. Ready to flip if needed.
DeployBot: deploy complete: green=100% blue=0% (timestamp=1784256830)
